mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2% over a 3-month window signals a tightening cycle, raising risk-free rates and discounting future corporate earnings, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2% and remains above for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) in periods where FEDFUNDS remains above 2% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3% quarter-over-quarter for two consecutive quarters signals improved corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth > 3% for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 exceeds 3% QoQ for two quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in UNRATE below 7% over two consecutive months indicates weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 7% and remains below for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods of sustained UNRATE < 7%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in INDPRO and a fall in HOUST over one month signals input cost inflation with stagnant housing demand, compressing corporate margins and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 0.5% while HOUST decreases > 2% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO rises and HOUST falls under the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in RSAFS over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer savings and reduced discretionary spending, which is expected to drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during three-month periods of declining RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in CPIAUCSL over two months signals a successful disinflationary tightening, which boosts market confidence and predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases while CPIAUCSL decreases over two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls concurrently for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PAYEMS above trend by more than 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports earnings growth and predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > trend by >0.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained above-trend PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in HOUST below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening housing demand, which is expected to negatively impact construction and retail sectors and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 12-month MA for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during four-month periods where HOUST remains below its 12-month moving average.
